question: Are there sidewalks or pedestrian walkways near any of the transformer pads? If yes, what is the distance from the transformer pads to the back of the nearest sidewalk? Do all pads maintain at least 2 feet clearance from the back of sidewalks?
checklistItemText: Transformer pads not located minimum 2 feet from back of sidewalks
